hypotheses.text: The current L2 cache configuration without a prefetcher is a significant bottleneck, and enabling a data-aware prefetcher like va_ampm_lite will substantially improve IPC by reducing LLC misses.

hypotheses.text: The L1D cache capacity is a primary bottleneck, and increasing its associativity by adding more sets will improve IPC by reducing L1D miss rates, which is more impactful than an L2 prefetcher.

hypotheses.name: C_server_l1d_prefetcher-no_l1d_sets-128_l1d_ways-12_l2_mshr-64_l2_prefetcher-spp_dev_l2_sets-1024_l2_ways-8_llc_mshr-128_llc_prefetcher-no_llc_replacement-lru_llc_sets-2048_llc_ways-16
hypotheses.text: The L2 prefetcher is currently the dominant performance knob, and further gains can be achieved by increasing L1D sets in conjunction with the best performing L2 prefetcher (spp_dev), as the LLC hit ratio is high enough to warrant L1D optimizations.

hypotheses.name: C_server_l1d_prefetcher-no_l1d_sets-64_l1d_ways-12_l2_mshr-64_l2_prefetcher-va_ampm_lite_l2_sets-1024_l2_ways-8_llc_mshr-128_llc_prefetcher-next_line_llc_replacement-lru_llc_sets-2048_llc_ways-16
hypotheses.text: While L2 prefetchers showed gains, the high LLC MPKI (12.7660 with va_ampm_lite) indicates that the LLC is still a bottleneck, and a more aggressive LLC prefetcher might unlock further performance, despite L2 prefetchers already reducing LLC traffic.

hypotheses.text: Despite the benefits of L2 prefetchers, performance is still limited by the L1D cache, and increasing L1D associativity or sets will yield higher IPC, even with a simpler LLC configuration.
